title: TFT Lab 0.2.0: Reproducible Tensor Invariance and Quadrature Sonification
description: TFT Lab is an alpha-status research prototype for deterministic tensor invariance experiments, quadrature signal construction, and scientific sonification. It provides executable numerical demonstrations and replay-oriented artifacts; it does not establish a validated physical theory.
notes: Alpha-status research software. Cite this software release or the repository; this metadata does not assert a separate conceptual-publication DOI.
